remarks: Completely renovated direct riverfront rental in the coveted Rowayton neighborhood with stunning water views and a peaceful private setting. This beautifully updated 1-bedroom, 1-full bath cottage features walls of glass, abundant natural light, exposed wooden beams, and a private deck overlooking the river and surrounding nature. A true retreat for nature lovers with serene views and beautiful sunsets right from home. Conveniently located within walking distance to town, train, and marina. Rare waterfront rental opportunity with modern updates throughout.
